label: Public benchmarks used to shape the SYNTHETIC year. Each figure names its source, table, data years and the URL it was read at. None of these is the founder's number.

ce_chicago.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Consumer Expenditure Surveys

not_read: Standard errors and coefficients of variation (only in BLS XLSX tables the tools could not read). The generator's month-to-month noise is therefore a stated assumption, not a published figure.
Category detail by income quintile (XLSX only).

ce_glossary.retirement_pensions_social_security: Per the BLS CE glossary, this category "includes all Social Security contributions paid by employees; employee contributions to railroad retirement, government retirement, and private pension programs; and retirement pro[grams]..." (the fetch cut the sentence there). So it holds the employee's FICA as well as pension saving.
